name: Dance With Penguin
description: Kindergarten motion-capture dance game. Kids dance in front of the camera and a cartoon penguin mirrors their moves, then replays the dance.
ai_concept: Sensing and Understanding — the camera senses body movements (like an AI sensing the world) and maps them onto a character
notes: Standalone. Uses MediaPipe Pose + Three.js. Webcam processed locally in-browser, no data leaves the device.
